_readme: Machine-checkable removal triggers for SYSTEM.md §13 (Active migrations & deprecation ledger). SYSTEM.md remains the source of truth for WHY each row exists and its traps; this file only encodes the triggers that can be evaluated mechanically. Run: python3 ~/.claude/skills/ai-slop-detector/scripts/ledger_check.py .  (add --strict for a non-zero exit on drift). Rows without triggers are prose/DB/build conditions — verify those by hand per SYSTEM.md. Keep row ids identical to §13.

rows.hand_check: The release after /mcp ships (v0.10.0): delete scripts/setup-mcp.sh, the host-venv paragraphs in docs/USING_MAESTRO.md, GETTING_STARTED.md and backend/mcp_server/README.md, and every docker exec mcp_server.server example. Keep maestro-career-studio-mcp as the maestro mcp fallback until B′. Machine predicates require the script absent and zero source matches; the release and prose removals are verified by hand.

HELD by owner 2026-08-09: LaTeX stays, both engines remain first-class; nothing waits on this row. Header defects fixed (Typst ulink(); LaTeX separator space), DB rows re-synced. The CLEAN 8/8 corpus predates the 2026-08-08 extractor swap (PyMuPDF to pypdfium2): re-run it before acting on those numbers.

DB condition: count of engine='latex' template rows must be 0 and stay 0 after GET /api/templates re-seeds. ALSO cover_letter.tex.j2 must have no caller, i.e. render_cover_letter(engine="latex") is unreachable — compile_cover_letter_pdf itself survives as the engine-dispatching entry point for both engines and is NOT the condition. Blocked on typst-default-flip.
XCharter is already vendored at backend/app/assets/fonts/xcharter/ (settings.typst_font_paths defaults there), so dropping the layer no longer changes Typst's font. Blocked on latex-render-path.
Stage 1 (frontend emits kind:'resume') not shipped; then DB check on chat_messages.meta_json selections.
API-shape condition: GET /api/settings/autofill returns education absent-or-array for a pre-normalization profile.

job_search_brief's identically named response fields are a frozen outward projection, NOT a legacy reader — deliberately outside the trigger paths. Also requires the Settings editor legacy bridge gone and GET /api/settings/autofill clean. Trigger paths are DIRECTORIES, not files: extension/content/ was widened 2026-08-02 after the phase-2 split moved the dual-read out of agent.js, and extension/panel/ was added after the panel's workAuthForWrite (actions/pause.js) turned out to promote the legacy pair before the first typed pause-row write while the content-only path read green. A file-pinned path goes green on the next rename without the reader dying.
No reader of jobs.location may remain (JobSummary still exposes only the old field), then op.drop_column.
Migration 85a1bb628e28. Cut when bullet_rewrites or health_ask_answers is dropped, or GET /api/resume-lint/{kind}/{key}/answers goes away. Miss path is fallback, not a competing product.

The always-on bot runs on the maestro command for one release (verify by hand). Then delete backend/scripts/native/, docs/native-install.md and tests/test_native_scripts.py. Machine predicate: the scripts folder is gone.

Regenerate backend/requirements.lock in python:3.12-slim with --unsafe-package nodejs-wheel-binaries (recipe in backend/Dockerfile). Until then the lock names maestro-career-studio-backend and lacks psutil; the image installs the project with --no-deps -e .

The release after this one has shipped (a sync peer that has not updated reads the stored `market` key). Then drop the `market` computed field from MarketSetting. Keep the legacy {"market": X} read until no stored market blob lacks `home` (DB check on settings key 'market').
